text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor b-u-i-l-t a p-e-r-s-o-n-a from c-h-a-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s to g-a-i-n v-i-c-t-i-m t-r-u-s-t and l-e-f-t a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor s-e-n-t a m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-t-r-e-a-m via w-h-a-t-s-a-p-p a-p-p-s to e-x-t-r-a-c-t e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d c-l-e-a-n-s-e-r.
3) the actor r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s with a r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t o-u-t-l-i-n-e and l-e-f-t a k-e-y-l-e-s-s h-o-l-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-y.
4) the actor b-l-o-c-k-e-d c-r-o-s-s v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n via a b-l-o-c-k l-i-s-t u-t-i-l-i-t-y and l-e-f-t a s-u-p-p-r-e-s-s-i-o-n n-o-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-l-e-v-e-n a-l-e-r-t.
5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d with a s-t-a-t-i-c r-e-p-o-r-t and l-e-f-t a c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-a-m-p w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k.
